payload.direct_answer: The reviewed clauses do not state that the telecom operator may share network degradation status with the health operator. The clauses state that the telecom operator must report significant network degradation to the telecom regulator, and that the telecom regulator may request incident information from the operator. Separately, the health data clauses restrict circulation of patient information and health data except in permitted cases or with patient written approval, but they do not address network degradation status as a data category. Whether network degradation status may be shared with the health operator, and what may be shared, is not identified in the provided evidence.

uae_evidence.relevance: Establishes the telecom operator's duty to report significant network degradation to the telecom regulator, not to the health operator.
Establishes the telecom regulator's power to request incident information from the telecom operator.
Restricts circulation of health data and information to permitted cases and requires confidentiality, integrity and availability.
Restricts circulation of patient information to health purposes or patient written approval, subject to listed exceptions.

options: The telecom operator reports significant network degradation to the telecom regulator under illus.telecom.incident-report.
The telecom regulator may request incident information from the telecom operator under illus.telecom.regulator-information-request.
Any sharing involving patient information or health data must comply with uae.fl2-2019.art4 and uae.fl2-2019.art16, including permitted cases or patient written approval.
Seek a determination from health_data_oversight and telecom_regulator on whether network degradation status falls within any permitted health-data circulation case.
uncertainty: The clauses do not define network degradation status as health data or patient information, so it is uncertain whether uae.fl2-2019.art4 and uae.fl2-2019.art16 apply to it.
The clauses do not identify any human decision-maker expressly authorised to approve sharing network degradation status with the health operator.
